rows.label: qst610402_msg0001
rows.name: S-someone's here...!?

rows.label: qst610402_msg0002
rows.name: S-should we use the prototype again?

rows.label: qst610402_msg0003
rows.name: Yeah. Let's fill them up with that!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0004
rows.name: Y-yeah. That's our only choice!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0101
rows.name: ...What? They're Tirkin, not ghosts.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0201
rows.name:
Thank goodness. Looks like they were
Tirkin, not ghosts.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0301
rows.name:
So the ones making noise late at night
were Tirkin, not ghosts, mo?

rows.label: qst610402_msg0401
rows.name:
Ah, so the rumored ghosts
appear to be just Tirkin...

rows.label: qst610402_msg0501
rows.name:
So the ones making noise late at night
were Tirkin?

rows.label: qst610402_msg0502
rows.name: Phew, that's a relief.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0601
rows.name: Y-you lot!?

rows.label: qst610402_msg0602
rows.name: I-I actually remember you!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0603
rows.name:
I haven't forgotten what happened in
Acedia!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0604
rows.name:
B-but if we fight, won't we lose
again...?

rows.label: qst610402_msg0605
rows.name: We should settle this peacefully.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0606
rows.name: Y-yeah. Peacefully.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0607
rows.name:
We are the Fire Dragons, a cooking
group renowned throughout the world.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0608
rows.name:
We wanted to open a restaurant in Alba
Margen, but they turned us down...

rows.label: qst610402_msg0609
rows.name:
S-so we're trying to make a fish dish
here so good it'll make your crest
fall off.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0610
rows.name:
But it's still a prototype, and
everyone we serve it to runs away.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0611
rows.name: T-t-tastes terrible!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0612
rows.name: We want you to help us.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0613
rows.name: No need to hesitate.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0614
rows.name: Remember what happened in Acedia!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0615
rows.name: First, help me with my cooking.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0616
rows.name: Then have our leader taste it.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0617
rows.name: If it gets 100 points, you pass.

rows.label: qst610402_msg0618
rows.name: If it's mediocre, you get zero!

rows.label: qst610402_msg0619
rows.name: Th-that's extreme!
